mapper.select: SELECT FROM reconcile_job_run WHERE reconcile_date=#{reconcileDate} AND merchant_no=#{merchantNo} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reconcile_diff( id,reconcile_date,diff_key,biz_type,diff_type, settlement_order_id,instruction_id,out_separate_no,separate_no,merchant_id, local_amount,channel_amount,local_fee_amount,channel_fee_amount, local_status,channel_status,detail,status,version,created_at,updated_at) VALUES( #{id},#{reconcileDate},#{diffKey},#{bizType},#{diffType}, #{settlementOrderId},#{instructionId},#{outSeparateNo},#{separateNo},#{merchantId}, #{localAmount},#{channelAmount},#{localFeeAmount},#{channelFeeAmount}, #{localStatus},#{channelStatus},#{detail},'OPEN',0,#{now},#{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM reconcile_diff WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM reconcile_diff WHERE resolve_request_key=#{resolveRequestKey} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE reconcile_diff SET status='RESOLVED', resolved_by_operator_id=#{operatorId}, resolve_request_key=#{resolveRequestKey}, resolve_note=#{resolveNote}, resolved_at=#{now}, version=version+1, updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND status='OPEN'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_order_count, COALESCE(SUM(merchant_share), 0.00) AS total_merchant_share, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(split_amount, 0.00)), 0.00) AS total_split_amount, COALESCE(SUM(platform_subsidy_due), 0.00) AS total_subsidy_due FROM settlement_order

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT merchant_id, DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m') AS period FROM settlement_order
GROUP BY merchant_id, DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m') ) AS grouped_subsidy

SELECT merchant_id, DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m') AS period, COUNT(*) AS order_count, COALESCE(SUM(paid_amount), 0.00) AS total_paid_amount, COALESCE(SUM(merchant_share), 0.00) AS total_merchant_share, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(split_amount, 0.00)), 0.00) AS total_split_amount, COALESCE(SUM(reversed_amount), 0.00) AS total_reversed_amount, COALESCE(SUM(platform_subsidy_due), 0.00) AS total_subsidy_due FROM settlement_order
GROUP BY merchant_id, DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY period DESC, merchant_id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT id,status,eligible_at,due_schedule_round,updated_at FROM settlement_order WHERE status='WAITING' AND eligible_at IS NOT NULL AND eligible_at <= #{cutoff} AND due_schedule_round > 0 ORDER BY eligible_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id,status,eligible_at,due_schedule_round,updated_at FROM settlement_order WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id,settlement_order_id,status,sent_at,created_at,updated_at FROM settlement_instruction WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
